card.name: More or most before an adjective
card.fires_on: The words "more" or "most" (sometimes "less") used as a degree word right before an adjective or adverb, mainly in older scientific prose such as Darwin-style natural history.

modes.label: more + adjective
modes.description: "More" or "less" placed before an adjective, forming a comparative.

modes.label: the most + adjective
modes.description: "Most" after "the" or "of the", meaning very or to the highest degree, before an adjective.
